name: Applesauce Snack Cake

instructions.primary_message: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat to 160°C (325°F). Line an 20-cm-square metal baking pan with a long strip of parchment to cover the bottom and 2 of the sides, then grease with cooking spray.

In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and baking soda. In a large bowl, whisk together applesauce, oil, honey, sugar, eggs, ginger, lemon zest, vanilla, and salt. Add flour mixture to applesauce mixture and whisk until just combined.

Using a rubber spatula, transfer batter to prepared pan and smooth top. Sprinkle evenly with crystallized ginger and remaining 2 tablespoons sugar. Bake until toothpick inserted in center of cake comes out clean, 35 to 40 minutes, rotating pan halfway through baking.
Let cake cool in pan on wire rack for 10 minutes. Remove cake from pan, discarding parchment, and let cool completely on rack, about 2 hours. Serve.

schema_metadata.keywords: Applesauce Snack Cake, snack cake, apple cake

description: This easy applesauce snack cake stays moist and tender for days, thanks to a smart balance of applesauce, olive oil, and honey, plus a kick of fresh ginger.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 2 hr 50 min.

Optional substitutions: homemade applesauce → store-bought unsweetened applesauce

Notes: I prefer the bold flavor of freshly grated ginger, but 1 1/2 teaspoons of ground ginger can be substituted for fresh ginger, if desired.
This recipe can easily be doubled and baked in a 9-by-33-cm metal baking pan. If doubling the recipe, bake the cake for about 40 to 45 minutes.
I like to measure my oil before my honey, so it is easier to get all the honey out of the measuring cup.

Make-ahead and storage: Cake can be lightly covered with plastic wrap or in an airtight container and stored at room temperature for up to 3 days.
author: Amanda Luchtel
